summary.text: Andrew Fagan is the Working Families Party and Democratic candidate for New York State Assembly District 124 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Christopher Friend.
He previously worked for the Cornell Cooperative Extension system for 31 years, according to his survey answers.

paragraphs.text: Fagan earned a high school diploma from Perth Central School and a bachelor's degree and a graduate degree from Cornell University.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up on an upstate dairy farm, earned a bachelor's degree in Animal Science and a Master of Arts in Teaching at Cornell, and worked 31 years for the Cornell Cooperative Extension system.

He said he was executive director of Cornell Cooperative Extension of Tioga County for 21 years and of Chemung County for 14 years, and served as interim executive administrator of the Food Bank of the Southern Tier in 2023.
He said he lives in Barton, New York.
Fagan said his priorities include making life more affordable, protecting SNAP and Medicaid funding, and supporting the New York Health Act, local farms and food systems.
He listed endorsements from the Chemung and Tioga County Democratic Committees, the Working Families Party and the NYS Public Employees Federation, AFL-CIO.
